HandleTypes.Description: An entity that manages the contextual action-hint legend (lives on the player)
One row of an action-hint legend - a child entity of its ActionHintDisplay
A carrier that publishes named transform attach points (hand, back) by gameplay tag for items to mount to
A backpack on a persistent world item: the list of its cargo slot child entities
A monster part with its own Health and HitZone, a condition ledger, spill to the body, and a depletion policy (detach a leg, break, none)
A character's body probe: a capsule probe at the capsule centre that resizes with the character's capsule (crouch, uncrouch)
A creature's decision layer: a CkGoap world state and planner, facts written only by request, and the current leaf action
The camp's session phase - Lobby (menu up, viewer pawns) or Live (chefs spawned) - mirrored from a CkStateMachine
One backpack cargo slot: a child of the pack with a capacity-1 inventory, a probe interactable and the stowed item's visual
An entity that can climb ladders: the ladders on offer, the one being climbed and how far up (lives on the player)
An entity whose interaction toggles or pulses an active state (lever, switch, hand wheel, seal)
A finite raw-food supply beside a cooking vessel: one left-hand transfer at a time, reserved then admitted by the cooking kernel
A logic node that a rising input charges to full and that drains one step at a time, asserting its mechanism source while charged
The legged crawler archetype: a procedural walker, one body part per leg with hurtboxes, a monster root, a navigator and a brain
An entity that steps through a timed table of gameplay-tagged phases, optionally looping
The attacker side of damage: resolves a hit probe to its zone, applies the team attitude gate and scale, and forwards the hit
A dicing minigame on a station: the pile's material state, the highlighted band on the board and the cleaver the operator's hand slides and chops with
The player's emote wheel: the entries it offers, whether it is open and which sector its pointer hovers
A character's eye node: rides at a fixed height above the capsule centre and eases across capsule resizes (crouch, uncrouch) instead of snapping
A face node showing two eyes: a style, emote and state expressions, blinking and a look offset pushed to a plate
A world source of an ingredient item: charges released on request, then exhausted, regrown or destroyed
The first-person gloves: reach/grip/return/hold/release/push phase owned by the Hands sub-HFSM, focus lean, hold and carry

A frying minigame on a station: admitted battered pieces (dynamic bodies keyed by their feed identity) that float, tumble and fry face by face below the oil line, a skimmer (a kinematic body) the operator dips, carries and pours, and a fixed drain basket outside the oil where a supported piece drains
An entity with a gate whose moving node slides between closed and open offsets
An eye node that picks the nearest detected owner in range and in front to look at, and exposes its yaw/pitch
A procedural melee swing of the player's hand: windup, strike and recovery poses on a timeline, as an offset in the hand's space
An entity that, while armed, hits whatever is inside its trigger and optionally pushes characters
An entity with hit points: a clamped float attribute, damage and heal requests drained by one processor, per-request signals and a once-only depletion
The item in the player's hands, derived from the selected hotbar slot, and its first-person held visual
Uses, drops and throws the item in the player's hands through a no-probe interactable on the player
A damageable zone: a zone tag, a damage-type reaction table, the Health it feeds and the hurtbox probes that link back to it
The player's hotbar: capacity-1 bag slot inventories plus one overflow slot, and the selected slot
A look-steered kinematic implement: a scene node tilted and lifted from the operator's look, carrying kinematic bodies into the physics world
An entity whose gameplay reads the CkIntent matcher of the input layer that drives it
An entity that has the interactable feature set
An entity that has interact prompt configuration (input action, text, color)
An entity that manages stacked interact prompt display (lives on the player)
A climbable ladder: its climb line and the two trigger zones that offer it to climbers
Per-world singleton that tracks every mechanism source and sink and pushes per-channel input counts to sinks
An entity powered by one or more mechanism input channels combined with a rule (gate)
An entity that asserts one mechanism output channel (lever, switch, gate-as-relay)
A creature root: team, body Health and zone, the parts roster, the Dead attribute and the death request
A scene-node entity that tweens its own offset between a start and an end pose
An entity that is active while enough entities are inside its trigger, releasing after a delay
An entity that can operate a station: the station it holds, kept by the station arbiter (lives on the player)
A scene node that swings sinusoidally about one rotation axis, easing in on start and settling on stop
A swinging hazard: an oscillator whose hazard is armed while it runs
A player's view: the CkCamera director, its view anchor (the rendered view's transform) and the interaction trace cast from it
Whether this entity's dynamic body rests on any of its target bodies (and on which): a recent contact, or asleep while resting; apart/resting edges and landings
A searing minigame on a station: admitted pieces (dynamic bodies keyed by their feed identity) on a hot pan (a kinematic body the operator's look tilts and lifts); each piece's face on the pan sears
A logic node that asserts its mechanism source once its sink's input channels rise in a set order
An operator point: where its one operator stands, the Use interaction that reserves it, the grip the gloves hold and an optional minigame state machine
Goal-to-steering navigation for a SurfaceMotion body: a path from the nav surface or a straight line, waypoint following and a stuck watchdog
A cycle-driven trap that arms a hazard and optionally moves a part per phase
A probe volume entity that tracks the entities inside it and fires OnEntityEntered/OnEntityExited
An item presented outside an inventory: pickable with physics in the world, or a visual in the player's hand
